comment: The statement that credible near-term applications tend to be assistive is useful, but “assistive” is not defined. Systems can still strongly influence human decisions while formally leaving the final decision to a person.

public.text: The statement that credible near-term applications tend to be assistive is useful, but “assistive” is not defined. Systems can still strongly influence human decisions while formally leaving the final decision to a person.
public.suggestedRevision: Define assistive use by the actual role of the system, level of automation, ability of users to understand and override outputs, time available for review, and consequences of disagreement.
